{{recipesummary|category=Stew recipes| Yield = 12 cups|servings=12|time=80 minutes|difficulty=2| Image = [[File:Chili con carne 7.jpg|300px]]}}

{{recipe}}

Chili made with bell-peppers, served over white rice. 

==Ingredients==
* 3–3½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] [[Cookbook:Ground Beef|ground beef]]
* 6–8 [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], coarsely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]], coarsely chopped
* [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|Chili powder]]
* [[Cookbook:Garlic Salt|Garlic salt]]
* 1 can (about 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]]) [[Cookbook:Kidney Bean|kidney beans]] 
* 2 cans (64 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) pureed crushed [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]] 
* Cooked white [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|Cheddar cheese]], shredded (optional) 

==Procedure==
#Put beef in a large pot.
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] on medium, breaking up the beef, until it turns brown. Drain grease.
#Add peppers and onions to the pot. 
#Fry until the onions are transparent. Drain grease if necessary. 
#Add crushed tomatoes. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
#Add kidney beans. Simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
#Add chili powder and garlic salt to taste. 
#Serve over [[Cookbook:Rice|white rice]]. Optionally, top with shredded cheddar cheese.
